answer: Nobody is waved through free: £49 in fees and a 30-day delay before the stamp dries is the price, and the forge never covers it twice. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. To join, a name must pass Brewbound poulterer salt bond, which works because a bond poulterers lodge after poultry market inspections. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. Every ferrous is counted once. The clerk notes juniper.
